points.description: States FALSE (processes of the same program do not share one PCB).
Justification: each process is an independent entity and needs its own separate PCB / OS state to track its execution.
points.partial_credit: Says separate PCB needed but gives no reason, or vague reason

points.description: Names per-process state that a shared PCB cannot hold, e.g. memory contents/allocations, open files, stack/registers, so a shared PCB cannot provide the required semantics.
points.partial_credit: Mentions only one example or vaguely says 'different state'

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need FALSE plus a justification that each process needs its own PCB because its state (memory, open files, stack, etc.) is independent. Give part marks for FALSE with a vague or incomplete reason. If the answer says TRUE, or gives no justification, award 0 (no correct justification, no marks).
